**Finding: compliant (MINCOMMIT)** — no redline proposed.

The RadialSpark agreement imposes no minimum purchase or volume commitment on Clear Capital:

- **Section 1(a)**: Services are retained "on a task by task basis" under mutually agreed Statements of Work; nothing obliges Company to order any volume.
- **Section 3(a)**: Compensation is "as set forth in each Statement of Work," on a time-and-materials basis plus reimbursed expenses — pay-for-what-you-order only.
- **Section 6(a)**: Either party may terminate for any or no reason on 15 days' notice whenever no Statement of Work is outstanding, so there is a clean exit.
- Targeted searches for "minimum", commit/purchase/volume, take-or-pay, shortfall, guaranteed hours, retainer and prepaid/non-refundable fees returned no responsive language.

This meets the **preferred** position (no minimum commitment; fees for usage/ordered Services), so the fallback true-up mechanics are unnecessary and no edit is warranted. Worth noting for the commercial file only: Section 3(b) lets Contractor change rates on 30 days' notice with no uplift cap — that is a pricing issue for a separate rule, not a commitment issue here.
